verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs describe an unauthenticated API for checking domain pricing across hundreds of TLDs, so a machine-readable price source exists. The evidence does not show that it returns separate registration, renewal, and transfer prices per TLD, or a bulk feed suited to comparison and budgeting. Missing for 10: documented per-TLD registration/renewal/transfer price fields, a bulk pricing feed or endpoint shape, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, pricing is machine-readable — an API or feed returns current registration/renewal/transfer prices per TLD so tooling can compare and budget

citations.quote: Check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs (no auth required)
Pass dryRun: true to run every pre-flight check (availability, price match, eligibility, funds, spend limit) without charging or creating anything
